# Lair 2.1.2

Lair now keeps a shared project intact when it downloads to a device for the first time.

- A shared project can no longer be taken over by a stray duplicate when it first downloads to a device.
- Lair now shows only its own projects when your team also uses another app.
- Lair on Android gives you your board, issues, issue details and comments.
- The phone has the same Team screen as the Mac, and the two stay in step.
- Share a project with other people and choose whether each one can view or edit.
- Shared projects are end-to-end encrypted, and projects you have not shared are never uploaded.
